lessons: Qualify an independent missing-condition premise before spending turns. A population plus border cochange cannot be relabeled as an isolated prerequisite recovery.
Original placement latch and completed ownership answer different questions. Read native HasDistrict and actual Members before treating zero native terrain sites as a missing-site branch.

Keep native terrain permission, whole operation permission, system protection and worked-food guard separate. A known legal plot with one missing technology is a premise, not the eventual automatic planning/completion.

When configured generation model is genuinely absent, retain successful daily maintenance plus bounded actual inventory facts, no alias or empty repeated POSTs; owner continues the unfinished task and records adoption0/costunknown.
